Titles should feature high contrast letter-spacing (tracking-[0.2em] to tracking-[0.3em] for overlines).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install missing animation/audio dependencies using yarn (e.g. `yarn add framer-motion gsap @gsap/react lenis lucide-react canvas-confetti howler`).
Update `public/index.html` to include Google Fonts for 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Cinzel', and 'Outfit'.
Build the complete experience in React JS with smooth Lenis scroll and Framer Motion / GSAP triggers.
Implement the Opening Sequence 'THE SEALED INVITATION' as the default view until opened, with state saved in localStorage or React state.
Ensure all buttons, tabs, inputs, lock toggles, audio buttons, and cards include proper `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='open-invitation-btn'`, `data-testid='tab-dress-code'`).
Ensure total mobile and desktop responsiveness with APCA accessible contrast levels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always specify transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Use generous spacing (2-3x typical padding) to create breathing room.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
